audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer said Fizz on all seven rows while the content layer and the packet read Fizz, Fizz, Fizz, Fizz, Skill, Lux, Lux. Rows 0-3 said Fizz but their whys described Lux chipping him down.
audit.why: Playful / Trickster's untargetable frames plus a 550-unit Urchin Strike beat an immobile Lux through the early levels; once Zhonya's is online she stasis-es the Chum the Waters burst and out-ranges him at 1175/3340.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side = Skill, phases[5..6].side = Lux, with phases[0..5].why rewritten so each sentence matches its verdict. Content win[0..6] already matched the packet, so no win[] edits were required.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] had 3 entries where 4 are expected, and no entry covered Seastone Trident maxing.
audit.why: Seastone Trident falls from 7s to 3s across its ranks and empowers his next attack, so his damage cadence spikes on W-max independently of items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never gives Playful / Trickster a cooldown, and never states that Seastone Trident is an auto-attack reset — the missing-interactions file flags exactly that.
audit.why: Playful / Trickster is 16/14/12/10/8s at 400 range with untargetable frames; Urchin Strike is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s and dashes 550 units applying on-hit; Seastone Trident is 7/6/5/4/3s and empowers the next attack; Chum the Waters is 120/100/80s from 1300 units and slows before the knock-up.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, enemyWin, breakdown.carry, dosFull[0], dosFull[1], dontsFull[2] and the new spikes[3] carry these numbers and the reset tell.

audit.why: It is the field that holds real cooldowns, and the whole matchup is timed off Playful / Trickster.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with 16s/8s on E, 8s on Q and 120s on R.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string and dontsFull[2].d the tradeBad string, both under unrelated titles (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED x2).
audit.why: The bodies did not answer their own titles.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten around Urchin Strike's 550-unit dash and the flank the shark comes from.

edits.before: E-poke from max range on his last-hits — the slow zone plus passive auto is your chip engine from level 1.
edits.after: Playful / Trickster is 16s at rank 1 and makes him untargetable — your Q is wasted the second he hops.

edits.before: Q joins: the root threat re-prices every step he takes past the wave's midline.
edits.after: Urchin Strike dashes 550 units through you and applies on-hit — he closes for free.

edits.before: Full kit: Q-E-auto with the passive detonations is a real chunk. Shield his answer and walk.
edits.after: Seastone Trident is 7s and resets his attack — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — E every wave contact. Bank Manaflow and hold Q for his aggression, not yours.
edits.after: His E is down to 10s by rank 4, so the untargetable window comes back faster than your Q.

edits.before: Final Spark online — anything the root catches dies to the laser math. The lane becomes a geometry quiz.
edits.after: Chum the Waters sticks from 1300 units, but a root banked before the shark lands keeps it even.

edits.before: Luden's spike: Q-E-R deletes squishies from root range. Force him to dodge or die on every contact.
edits.after: Zhonya's online: stasis through the shark, then poke a Fizz whose E is spent from 1175 units.

edits.before: - Fizz Playful / Trickster: matchup-defining — The untargetable hop dodges your whole combo — bait it before spending your burst. It governs your forward steps. - W Prismatic Barrier spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Playful / Trickster (E): 16s at rank 1, 8s at rank 5 — untargetable frames that eat a whole combo, so bait it before you spend. - Urchin Strike (Q) is 8s and dashes 550 units. - Chum the Waters is 120s at rank 1: once it is spent, the lane is yours to farm.

edits.before: Fizz wins by landing Playful / Trickster, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Fizz wins by dodging your root inside Playful's untargetable frames, then sticking Chum the Waters from 1300 units.

edits.before: Carry through the root-laser pipeline — one binding per fight, converted at screen range; your job is owning the geometry that makes it land.
edits.after: Carry by spending Light Binding after his hop, never before — a Fizz with E down is a 550-unit dash and no untargetable frames at all.

edits.before: The untargetable hop dodges your whole combo — bait it before spending your burst. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Playful is 16s at rank 1 — hold Light Binding until the hop resolves, because while it lasts he simply cannot be hit.

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, weave the passive auto, and keep Q visibly loaded — the chip is free and the root threat does the zoning.
edits.after: A centered wave keeps you outside Urchin Strike's 550 units, and warded flanks mean the shark never arrives from your blind side.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown and facing the dive with an empty root slot — Lux without the binding banked is everyone's favorite snack.
edits.after: Standing still to detonate at half health is exactly the 550-unit window Urchin Strike wants — detonate early and keep walking.
Seastone Trident falls to a 3-second cooldown and resets his attack, so the auto wind-up, not the ability cast, is your cue to step back.

notes: Full layer said Fizz on every row while content win[] and packet.levelChart both read Fizz x4, Skill, Lux, Lux; content was right, so the three side edits form one atomic group with no win[] twins needed. Rows 0-3 kept their side but had whys describing Lux winning, so those four are rewritten too. Left `ahead`, breakdown.wave, breakdown.late and breakdown.feeding templated — no Fizz-specific fact available to ground them without inventing. Not written because unverified: whether Chum the Waters' fish can be blocked or removed once attached, and whether Prismatic Barrier's shield prevents the fish from sticking — the kit flags it as a projectile but says nothing about either.
